# Rotaract Club of Dr. N.G.P Arts & Science College

> Official website of the Rotaract Club of Dr. N.G.P Arts & Science College, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Parented by the Rotary Club of Coimbatore Meridian (Club ID 217835), Rotary International District 3206. Motto: Service Above Self.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.rotaractdrngpasc.in/): about the club, projects, members, bulletins, how to join, blood requests, FAQ and contact details
- [Apply for membership](https://www.rotaractdrngpasc.in/pages/apply.html): membership application for students and young professionals aged 18 to 30
- [Blood request](https://www.rotaractdrngpasc.in/pages/blood-request.html): submit an urgent blood request
- [Games](https://www.rotaractdrngpasc.in/pages/games.html): club games portal
